requirements.text: The system shall show available rooms for the selected dates and number of guests.
ac: Rooms with no availability on any selected night are hidden.
requirements.note: module column is a merged cell spanning all rows

requirements.text: The system shall not allow a check-out date earlier than or equal to the check-in date.
ac: Same-day check-out shows a validation error.
requirements.note: module column is a merged cell spanning all rows

requirements.text: The system shall allow free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in.
ac: Cancellation 47 hours before charges one night.
requirements.note: module column is a merged cell spanning all rows

requirements.text: The system must hold a reservation for 15 minutes while payment is in progress.
ac: After 15 minutes without payment the hold is released.
requirements.note: module column is a merged cell spanning all rows

requirements.text: The system shall display prices in the currency selected by the guest.
ac: Switching currency updates all prices on the page.
requirements.note: module column is a merged cell spanning all rows
